alerts.reason: The year-over-year revenue decline narrowed from 7.62% in March to 1.84% in June. I expect growth to stay above −5.00% in the intervening quarter, supported by continued automotive growth, then fall to −5.00% or below in the quarter starting September 29. From June’s rate, a deterioration of 3.16 percentage points would reach the threshold. Record A identifies the downside risk: automotive growth only partly offset weaker industrial and energy demand over the fiscal year.
